basic_info.description: For the first time in over 45 years, 2055-2059 Powell Street is on the market. Owned and meticulously maintained by the same family, this beautifully preserved North Beach building is full of charm and opportunity. Featuring six matching units with high ceilings, great natural light, and timeless appeal, it's ideal for investors seeking steady income in a prime location. The property also offers two vacant parking spaces, providing additional rental value, and an entire lower level perfect for another revenue-generating concept. Located in the heart of vibrant North Beach, surrounded by popular restaurants and attractions, this is a rare chance to own a historic, income-producing property with incredible upside potential. Don't miss this opportunity to invest in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods!
